answer: Peers weight votes by stake and history, and a plume of verified endorsements is required before rewards unlock, making each fake reputation slot cost a forfeitable bond plus sustained labor. Each agent must stake a bond and maintain a public atlas of attested work history; new identities start at a mesa of zero reputation, so a sybil cluster gains no standing without costly real contributions. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
